title: P7: the ephemeral spaces of one deploy (design v3 W1 and W2), the Seq rules (W3) and the HashSet store (W4): the book of a root evaluation, the sweep at each root entry, the dangling ids of ended deploys, the claims and the send rule of seq spaces, the qualifier gate, and the unit rules of a HashSet collection, and the theory seam (W5): the builtin theories, the admission of a send, the theory at a match, the identity of a theory and its bytes (decision 74), and gate 4.
design: P7 design v3 (.reified-rspaces-work/p7/design-v3.md), sections 3, 4, 5, 6 and 9. The headline ids are the ids of the P7 phase of formal/reified-rspaces-invariant-map.json.
code_base: The items are in the P7 commits of this repository. The line numbers are informative. The checker finds each item by its scope and name.

V1.name: sweep_complete
V1.statement: When the lock keys of every transaction of a root evaluation cover the channels that it stages (readiness review S2), the book of the evaluation holds every staged volatile channel, and the sweep of the book leaves no record, no join entry and no waiting continuation on them (design v3 VR-2).

V2.name: dead_ephemeral_dangling
V2.statement: The spaces of two deploys are disjoint (I-19), so a space of another deploy is never live in this evaluation, and the live check passes exactly the spaces that this evaluation created (design v3 DG-1).

V3.name: seq_name_iff
V3.statement: The name of a space is a seq name exactly when its space is a live ephemeral space that is not exempt; every seq name decodes to a name of a live ephemeral space; the handle of a space and the names of a durable space are never seq names (design v3 SQ-1).

V4.name: SeqExclusive
V4.statement: For each channel of a seq space, the admitted uses form one prefix chain of participant paths: every admitted use descends from the previous one (design v3 SQ-3, SQ-4, decision 73).

V5.name: SeqNotSent
V5.statement: No delivered message holds a seq name; the channel argument of the own produce of a handle call is exempt (design v3 SQ-2).

V6.name: QualifierSupport
V6.statement: Gate 3 creates a HashSet space only with seq, and a seq space only in native execution (design v3 QT-4, QT-5).

V7.name: UseBalance
V7.statement: The use context of each participant is its lexical context: the body of a use block runs with its space, and the rest of the process keeps the context of its parent.

V8.name: ClaimTracksLastUse
V8.statement: The claim of a channel of a seq space is its last admitted use, and a channel has a claim exactly when it has an admitted use (design v3 SQ-4).

V9.name: hashset_unit_rules
V9.statement: The payload check of a HashSet collection accepts exactly the empty payload and its pattern check exactly the empty pattern list with no binder and no remainder. An empty pattern list matches exactly the empty payload, a rejected send or receive stages nothing, and so every record of a HashSet store is a unit (design v3 HS-2, HS-3, HS-5).

V10.name: builtin_decidable_structural
V10.statement: With a limit of at least one unit, each builtin decides every value by its shape as TH-1 states, never Undetermined, with the usage {1, 0} and one reserved unit; a match checks every stored value for one unit; a limit of 0 gives Undetermined before any reservation (design v3 TH-1, TH-8).

V11.name: fail_closed
V11.statement: A send is admitted exactly when every value is Proven; otherwise it aborts at its first value that is not, with TheoryRefuted or TheoryUndetermined and its index; a commit with two or more leases is refused (design v3 TH-5, TH-9).

V12.name: usage_cache_transparent
V12.statement: A cache whose entries are results of the check gives the verdict and the reserved units of the check on a hit and a miss, and stays consistent (design v3 TH-8).

V13.name: resolve_identity_deterministic
V13.statement: The resolution is a function of the content of the identity: exactly the structural builtins resolve, with any limit profile, and every identity that the factory builds resolves to its kind (design v3 TH-2, TH-3).

V14.name: replay_preserves_theory_admission
V14.statement: Replay decodes the persisted identity bytes and admits or refuses each send as play does, at the same index and with the same reserved units; an identity that names no checker fails the send (design v3 TH-5, TH-7, TH-8).

V15.name: identity_bytes_roundtrip
V15.statement: The decoder of the identity bytes inverts the encoder, accepts only the image of the encoder, and the encoder is injective (decision 74).

V16.name: theory_refusal_is_guard_refusal
V16.statement: The theory of the space at a match is part of the guard: a fire binds a stored record that the guard and the theory admit, a theory refusal is a guard refusal, a refused first match parks, a theory that proves every datum changes no choice, and a datum in flight is never checked (design v3 TH-6).

V17.name: theory_gate_validated
V17.statement: Gate 4 passes no theory and the builtin names without arguments; a builtin with arguments fails with BadConstructorArgument, another name with UnknownTheory and the least builtin within two edits; gate 4 runs after gate 3 and before the params gates (design v3 TH-4).

items.name: ephemeral_space
items.role: The space of a space-scoped id with an ephemeral KIND.

items.name: VolatileRegistry
items.role: The book of one root evaluation: its ephemeral spaces and the volatile channels that its transactions locked.

items.name: record_locked
items.role: Records the volatile lock keys of a transaction (VR-2).

items.name: record_space
items.role: Records an ephemeral space after its creation commits.

items.name: take_channels
items.role: Takes the volatile channels of the evaluation for its sweep.

items.name: begin
items.role: Opens each transaction and records its volatile lock keys first.

items.name: sweep_volatile
items.role: Sweeps the book under the boundary guard at the end of a root evaluation (VR-4 to VR-8).

items.name: check_live
items.role: DG-1 for a routed channel.

items.name: check_live_space
items.role: DG-1 for a space reference.

items.name: record_ephemeral_space
items.role: The factory records a created ephemeral space before its reply.

items.name: begin_root_evaluation
items.role: The root predicate of VR-3: only a root evaluation resets the book.

items.name: end_root_evaluation_observed
items.role: The sweep at the end of a root evaluation, on the Ok and the Err path (VR-4, VR-8).

items.name: check_route_live
items.role: DG-1 at the send and receive hooks.

items.name: SeqClaims
items.role: The claims of one program job on the channels of one seq space (SQ-3, SQ-4).

items.name: ClaimRole
items.role: The role of a use: a data channel, or a channel of the group of a waiting receive.

items.name: open
items.role: Opens the claims of a program job on a seq space with the participant path of its operation order.

items.name: claim
items.role: Admits a use when the channel has no claim or its claim is a prefix of the participant path (SQ-3).

items.name: store
items.role: Stores the pending claims after a successful commit (SQ-4).

items.name: seq_spaces
items.role: The seq spaces of the evaluation, the live set of SQ-1.

items.name: claim
items.role: Claims the channels of each staging primitive of a program job on a seq space.

items.name: run_plan
items.role: Runs a join-engine plan with the claims of its job and stores them after the commit.

items.name: own_claims
items.role: Claims the own channels of a join-engine operation: the home of a datum, or the channel of each own collection.

items.name: OpOrigin
items.role: The origin of a space job. An internal job (a re-issue) claims nothing, so the model has no step for it.

items.name: space_op_from
items.role: Runs a space operation with its origin; the re-issue branch passes OpOrigin::Internal.

items.name: check_send
items.role: SQ-2: scans the message of a send for seq names, with the forwarder hop and the own channel argument exempt.

items.name: check_unforgeable
items.role: SQ-1: an unforgeable is a seq name when it is a name of a live seq space that is not exempt.

items.name: Execution
items.role: The execution model of a factory call (QT-5).

items.name: validate_in
items.role: Gate 3 in the execution model of the deploy: legacy execution refuses seq (QT-5).

items.name: execution
items.role: The execution model of the deploy that the runtime evaluates.

items.name: wrap_body
items.role: Wraps a stored body in the USE tuple of its lexical context.

items.name: eval_use
items.role: Runs the body of a use block with its space as the context, and leaves the context of the rest.

items.name: HashSetOuter
items.role: The HashSet store: the key, the channels and the names of the HashMap store, with the unit rules (HS-1).

items.name: check_payload
items.role: HS-2: a send to a HashSet collection carries the empty payload, before any staging.

items.name: check_patterns
items.role: HS-3: a bind on a HashSet collection has no pattern, no binder and no remainder, before any staging.

items.name: TheoryUsage
items.role: The logical work and the evidence of one check (F1r3lang AdmissionUsage).

items.name: TheoryVerdict
items.role: The verdict of a check: Proven, Refuted or Undetermined; only Proven admits.

items.name: resolve
items.role: TH-3: the checker of an identity in this build, a structural builtin or TheoryUnavailable.

items.name: admit_values
items.role: TH-5: the values of a send in order; the first that is not Proven aborts with its index; the leases in order.

items.name: BuiltinKind
items.role: The five structural builtins.

items.name: contains
items.role: TH-1: the shape test of a builtin.

items.name: sole
items.role: The one expression of a value with every other field empty and no connective.

items.name: of_identity
items.role: TH-3: a structural identity with a builtin theorem id and no args, any limit profile.

items.name: check
items.role: TH-1 and TH-8: a starved limit is Undetermined before any reservation; else one unit, then the shape.

items.name: check_match
items.role: TH-6: every value of the stored payload, for one unit.

items.name: TheoryIdentity
items.role: TH-2: the content identity of a theory, never a handle.

items.name: builtin
items.role: The identity that the factory builds for a builtin name.

items.name: to_bytes
items.role: Decision 74: the canonical bytes of the identity, which the config holds.

items.name: from_bytes
items.role: Decision 74: the strict decoder of the identity bytes.

items.name: of
items.role: TH-5: the theory of the config and the admission of the values of a send, before any staging or bump.

items.name: check_leases
items.role: TH-9: two or more leases abort with NestedCommitGuard before the commit.

items.name: admits
items.role: TH-6: the guard, then the theory on the stored data of the match.

items.name: theory_admits
items.role: TH-6: check_match on each stored datum; a verdict other than Proven refuses.

items.name: matches
items.role: TH-6: the spatial match, the guard, and the theory only for a datum held in the store.

items.name: admits_records
items.role: TH-6: the stored members of a list, each checked after the guard.

items.name: theory_gate
items.role: TH-4: gate 4 of the factory constructor.

items.name: from_par_metered
items.role: TH-7: each config read decodes the identity bytes and resolves them.
